text:
tara: Heads-up — BrightApps asked us to onramp Kingfisher-14b (fp16) for their rerank flow. They need ~<20ms p50 on A100-like hw and want a private deployment. High business priority. Can we triage?

james: On it. Do we have a weights link + tokenizer info? Also need a target quant goal (int8 vs int4) and perf SLOs.

tara: Link: https://s3.company/brightapps/kingfisher-14b/v1 (weights + model-card). Tokenizer: SentencePiece, vocab 50k. Customer: ~2M qps-month, latency sensitive.

olga: Quick note — Kingfisher uses a slightly different eos id; we should add tokenizer sanity tests. For quant target: suggest start with int8/ggml-int8 then evaluate int4 if perf required.

quant-bot: auto-smoke triggered by intake: running baseline fp16 eval on our smoke suite (1000 prompts). ETA ~12m. Command: ```./eval_smoke --model s3://brightapps/kingfisher-14b/v1 --suite smoke_rerank --out /tmp/kf_baseline.json```

sam: infra note: fp16 size ~28GB. With KV cache expect 32–36GB runtime. A100-40GB probably fine for single replica but <24GB will struggle unless we enable sharding/offload. Planning sched slot?

nina: PM/CS note — BrightApps requires SOC2 + customer-managed VPC for prod. They'll want an isolated Dedicated or Private deployment. Keep security checklist in scope.

james: Proposed triage checklist (quick):
- verify tokenizer mapping + sample decode/encode roundtrips
- baseline fp16 smoke perf + quality
- int8 quantize sweep (LLM.int8) -> eval BLEU/rr/ndcg on their prompt set
- int4 exploratory if int8 misses perf target
- memory/cost estimate for Dedicated vs Private
- compliance checklist (KMS, audit logs)
Can pick up baseline + int8 smoke.

tara: Owner: @james for ML bring-up, @sam for infra provisioning, @olga for quant/quality. Target: baseline smoke + int8 smoke in 3 working days. I'll add to intake board. :calendar:

olga: I'll take the int8 sweep. Will reuse the rerank eval harness and push prompts to /datasets/brightapps/rerank_v1.

sam: Scheduling note — I reserved a 4-hr run on a 80GB gpu node tomorrow 10:00 PT for quant experiments. Please post any special requirements.

quant-bot: smoke results ready: baseline fp16 p50=19ms, p95=46ms, rerank_ndcg=0.842. int8 quant (per our default recipe) -> p50=15ms, p95=38ms, ndcg=0.836 (delta -0.7%). int4 quick try -> p50=11ms, ndcg=0.809 (delta -3.9%). Full sweep scheduled. Raw: /artifacts/kingfisher/smoke/1748250478.json

james: Good initial numbers. int8 looks promising (within -1% quality). Next: run the customer's rerank suite and run stability tests (long chats + cache warm). Also validate tokenizer edge-cases.

tara: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and attach the artifact links. If int8 holds on the full suite we can propose a Dedicated deployment with 1 primary + 1 warm standby.

nina: I'll draft the customer onboarding email and include compliance checklist + expected timeline.

sam: Will follow up on network/VPC kickoffs once we confirm Dedicated.

olga: tagging follow-ups: I'll post the int8 sweep params in the RK board and add a note about EOS mapping.

james: moving to the intake pipeline now. Will update thread when full eval finishes.
